values.joint: MX Tune Pro / Base maps on the motorcycle
values.value: 2 base map settings (MAP 1 and MAP 2); M button illuminated blue when MAP 2 is selected
conditions: MX Tune Pro User Guide, publication 9901790 Issue 2 (2025); the guide names no model year; applies to Triumph TF models fitted with the genuine Wifi Module Kit

values.joint: MX Tune Pro / Factory map FI value meaning

conditions: MX Tune Pro User Guide, publication 9901790 Issue 2 (2025); the guide names no model year; applies to Triumph TF models fitted with the genuine Wifi Module Kit

values.joint: MX Tune Pro / Factory map IG value meaning

conditions: MX Tune Pro User Guide, publication 9901790 Issue 2 (2025); the guide names no model year; applies to Triumph TF models fitted with the genuine Wifi Module Kit

values.joint: MX Tune Pro / Factory maps target

conditions: MX Tune Pro User Guide, publication 9901790 Issue 2 (2025); the guide names no model year; applies to Triumph TF models fitted with the genuine Wifi Module Kit

values.joint: MX Tune Pro / GPA (traction control) adjustment range
values.value: 1 - 10 (1 least, 10 most traction control); 0 = traction control off
conditions: MX Tune Pro User Guide, publication 9901790 Issue 2 (2025); the guide names no model year; applies to Triumph TF models fitted with the genuine Wifi Module Kit

values.joint: MX Tune Pro / LC (launch control) adjustment range
values.value: 0 - 20 (0 least, 20 most launch control); at 0 launch assist acts as a rev limiter only
conditions: MX Tune Pro User Guide, publication 9901790 Issue 2 (2025); the guide names no model year; applies to Triumph TF models fitted with the genuine Wifi Module Kit

conditions: MX Tune Pro User Guide, publication 9901790 Issue 2 (2025); the guide names no model year; applies to Triumph TF models fitted with the genuine Wifi Module Kit
